from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted identifiers from a single legal document to match against outcome options."""
    case_numbers: list[str] | None = Field(description="Official case numbers mentioned in the document")
    courts: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of the courts involved in the case")
    appellants: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of appellants in appeal cases")
    applicants: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of applicants in reconsideration cases")
    respondents: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of respondents or defendants")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case, e.g., 'Administrative Execution', 'Inheritance Dispute'")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="The main verdict or decision text")
    fee_details: str | None = Field(description="Specific text regarding court fees and amounts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseRecord]
